author: Bellular News
description:
The $55 billion sale of EA is done. Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund owns 93% of the company. Financial reporting died within twelve hours of the close, and $20 billion of the purchase debt now sits on EA's books. EA has promised its lenders $400 million in savings within a year. That means layoffs and cancelled games, on top of the 2,500 people already cut since 2022. But while that sounds great for their new backers, for the Saudis, it's not all about the money.
